agentsLanding.subtitle: Choose an agent to get started.
agentsLanding.executiveSummaryDesc: Condense long content into a crisp leadership brief.
agentsLanding.docCompareDesc: Compare two document versions and see what changed.
agentsLanding.hrAgentDesc: Leave balances, applying for leave, medical certificates, and company policies.
agentsLanding.digitalAttestationDesc: Review Hub — inspect agent confidence, documents, and approve or reject attestation cases.
agentsLanding.docIntelAgentDesc: Analyze certificates and documents — extract key facts, flag risks, verify against source, and ask questions.
agentsLanding.translatorAgentDesc: Detect a document's language, translate it page by page, and analyze it just like Document Intelligence.
agentsLanding.grammarAgentDesc: Paste text or upload a document — check grammar, spelling, punctuation, style, and clarity, then ask questions about it.
agentsLanding.contractAnalyzerDesc: Analyze contracts — detect the parties, clarify open questions, assess risk across every category, and ask the agent about the result.
agentsLanding.mofaChatbotDesc: Chat or talk with the MOFA virtual assistant — ask about attestation, passports, and Golden Visa services, with a staff backoffice for the knowledge base, crawl schedule, and moderation.
agentsLanding.emailComposeAgentDesc: Compose new emails from a brief, or draft replies to a thread after answering a few clarifying questions — with tone variants, translation, and a pre-send checklist.
agentsLanding.nxFinAiDesc: Analyzes financial data to track cash flow, monitor financial metrics/performance, and highlight emerging risks—helping teams strengthen financial planning and make informed decisions.
agentsLanding.nxRfpAnalyzerDesc: Analyzes RFP documents to extract key requirements, prerequisites criteria, deadlines, deliverables, and evaluation parameters—helping teams prepare complete, aligned proposals.
agentsLanding.nxQuoteComparatorDesc: Compares vendor quotations across scope, price, specifications, and commercial terms, highlighting differences and exclusions to support purchasing decision making.
agentsLanding.nxAiAdvisorDesc: An upcoming advisory agent — full capabilities are still in development.
agentsLanding.nxLegalAiDesc: Reviews contracts and legal documents to summarize key clauses, flag potential risks, and support legal teams with research and drafting with respect to the law of the land.
